shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI steps out of the midnight airport exit doors dragging a silver suitcase, his all-black suit and rimless glasses pressed into a pure silhouette by neon backlight.
shots.sub: 那天夜里，熊家的第二只手——落地了。
shots.speaker: 旁白
shots.fx: 航班轰鸣余音+行李箱轮声

shots.detail_en: XIONG lowers the window of the black limousine at the airport curb himself for the first time in ten years, greeting XIONGWEI with a serene smile.
shots.sub: 您从不接机。／市场需要两只手的时候——我亲自来接。
shots.speaker: 熊伟+熊天成

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI spreads a portable terminal on his knees in the back seat, the 1993-era data streams flowing green across his rimless glasses.
shots.sub: 93 年的数据包，我在飞机上拆完了。他父亲的打法——每一步，我都算得出置信度。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONG and XIONGWEI stand shoulder to shoulder before the main screen of the Lianhua Tower server room, algorithm panels and scanned hand-drawn candlesticks projected side by side as the two bloodlines of the trade converge.
shots.sub: 算法归我，做局归您。／不。从今晚起——都归市场。
shots.speaker: 熊伟+熊天成
shots.fx: 服务器低鸣+低音威胁动机

shots.detail_en: XIONG and XIONGWEI's twin silhouettes merge into one black mass on the frosted-glass door of the server room as it swings shut.
shots.sub: 明天，给全港海的人——上一课。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH spreads the freshly sketched battle page of his father's notebook under a desk lamp while RED and MANCANG lean over the same table for the war council.
shots.sub: 明天他一定反扑——而且是双线一起。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH's pen tip stops on the 'feigned weakness' cell among three hand-drawn scenarios and slowly circles it.
shots.sub: 最凶的打法——是先装死。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: RED slides her ledger open toward CH, fingertip tapping three lines of figures that refuse to balance.
shots.sub: 这三天的账，处处对不上——像有人在暗处，把脚印全擦了。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH turns the notebook back to its final page and presses his thumb onto the one missing blank line, holding still for two long seconds.
shots.sub: 爸，明天这一仗，按你的打法打。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG climbs onto a teahouse stool to drill his retail recruits, his loud floral shirt raised overhead like a regimental flag.
shots.sub: 都记住军规——手不许抖，单不许乱！／军团长，到底打哪儿？／陆先生指哪儿，咱们打哪儿！
shots.speaker: 满仓+散户甲

shots.detail_en: CH pulls MANCANG aside and grips his shoulder, and for once MANCANG's grin drops away entirely.
shots.sub: 明天不管盘面多凶，你只做一件事——让大家别乱。／明白！这回我不梭哈，我守仓——我满仓，守仓！
shots.speaker: 长虹+满仓

shots.detail_en: CH stands alone before the dead great board in the emptied midnight hall, small before it like a man before a darkened altar.
shots.sub: 十年前，他为一场行情准备了一夜。十年后——轮到我了。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH checks his father's slow-by-one-minute pocket watch, its second hand trailing one tick behind the distant wall clock.
shots.sub: 市场快我一步——我就，让它快这一步。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH stands with the packed hall at the opening bell of the decisive day, every face turned upward to the board.
shots.sub: 来了来了！今天——见生死！
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: CH's eyes catch the Lianhua Industrial cell where the selling pressure vanishes mid-air and the price suddenly refuses to move.
shots.sub: 熊家……怂了？！
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: XIONG, seated behind the VIP-box curtain as it is slowly drawn shut, closes his eyes and turns his prayer beads with a benevolent smile.
shots.sub: 全线撤防。让他们，先看看我输的样子。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: MANCANG leaps onto a stool with both fists thrown high as the hall erupts in premature triumph.
shots.sub: 他怂了！熊天成怂了！！冲啊兄弟们——
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: RED's head snaps up from her counter, pen tip frozen above the ledger page without a single further stroke.
shots.sub: 不对——撤得太整齐了。整齐得，像排练过。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH stares at the board, the green light sinking through his pupils layer by layer as he reads the trap beneath the calm.
shots.sub: 他在把陷阱，铺得更深。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: XIONG's eyes open behind the curtain and CH's gaze holds from the floor below — two silhouettes facing off through the drawn drape.
CH tucks the notebook under his arm and walks back-first into the backlit crowd, his silhouette swallowed by the sea of heads.
shots.sub: 猎人收爪的时候——从来不是认输。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Black end-card with white title text teasing the next episode.
shots.card: 他退的每一步，都是刀往回拉。下集《第九根阴线》
